LESSON: MANNERS OF

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1.2: Manners of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Manners of. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate eating (Suggested time – 1 lesson)
2. practice Islamic manners of eating according to the sunnah (traditions) of the prophet (S.A.W.)
3. acquire Islamic phrases used before and after eating appropriately

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate eating (Suggested time – 1 lesson)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate eating (Suggested time – 1 lesson). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. practice Islamic manners of eating according to the sunnah (traditions) of the prophet (S.A.W.)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice Islamic manners of eating according to the sunnah (traditions) of the prophet (S.A.W.). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. acquire Islamic phrases used before and after eating appropriately
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acquire Islamic phrases used before and after eating appropriately. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Manners of.
2. Explain Manners of to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Manners of.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate eating (Suggested time – 1 lesson)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Manners of. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Manners of important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate eating (Suggested time – 1 lesson)
2. practice Islamic manners of eating according to the sunnah (traditions) of the prophet (S.A.W.)
3. acquire Islamic phrases used before and after eating appropriately

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
